atomic_model: one diagnostic check resolves one evidence_id
strategy: Ignore already CONFIRMED and REJECTED hypotheses.
Take the unique union of missing required evidence across unresolved hypotheses; duplicate checks are removed.
Prefer the lowest-cost available check per evidence_id.
Read-only checks are allowed by default; mutating checks require explicit allow_mutating authorization.
Order checks deterministically by read-only status, cost, then evidence_id.
If required evidence has no authorized check, report it as blocked and keep the plan non-executable.
